name: الستور · Al-Store
buyer: Owner of one household-goods and electrical-appliances shop in Egypt (first pilot in Beni Suef), 2-6 staff, one counter PC
problem: Fast price rises, shop instalments, serial warranty, unrecorded discounts/returns and drawer differences are tracked on paper; money and stock leak without the owner seeing where.
core_journey: Open shift with a float, sell by barcode/keyboard (serial for appliances) with cash/card/wallet/InstaPay/finance company/on account/shop instalments, print the receipt, take a return linked to the sale line with a manager's approval, close the shift by counting; the owner sees every difference.

data.backup_restore_plan: Checked SQLite online backups every 4 hours and before restore/migration; restore on a clean PC is a field acceptance gate (PENDING).
data.retention_policy: Shop owner's decision; national ID optional and permission-gated. Egypt PDPL review PENDING.
data.residency: On the shop's own PC only; no cloud.

competitors.name: Daftra
competitors.price_notes: USD plans; offline hardware POS only on the top plan

competitors.name: Odoo
competitors.price_notes: about USD 31 per user per month (third-party listing)

competitors.name: Loyverse
competitors.differentiator: Simple POS; no shop instalments or serial warranty (UNVERIFIED)

acceptance: A one-product cash sale with change takes under 10 seconds by keyboard and never records twice on retry.
Discounts above the seller's limit, prices under minimum/cost and going over a credit limit need another person's password; wrong tries count toward lockout.
Returns refund at most what was paid for that line and are shown in the owner's eye.
Without a valid device-bound licence code the shop can read, export and back up but cannot sell or change data.
No page wider than the screen or text out of its card at 360/390/820/1366 px in Arabic and English; UI Lab budgets pass on a 4x slower CPU.

evidence.market_review: Desk research 2026-10-08 (docs/01-research.md in coolman1984/Store); field interviews with 5 shops PENDING
evidence.security_review: Automated negative checks (CSP, Host/Origin, roles, approvals, append-only ledger) PASS; independent review PENDING
